welcome: Welcome! Find, check and understand your new postcode by speaking. We do not ask for your name, phone number or NIN. Your location is used once to find your postcode and is not kept. Voice notes are deleted after we read them.
declined: No problem. Nothing was saved. You can come back any time.
ask_knew_before: Before we start: did you know your new postcode before today?
menu: What would you like to do? Tap the microphone and speak, share your location to get your postcode, or type a postcode to check it.
ask_location: To find your postcode, stand at your building and tap "Get my postcode" to share your location.
confidence_low: This is the nearest building we found, {distance} m away. If you can, compare it with the postcode plate on your building.
postcode_not_found: The official postcode database has no postcode for this spot yet. Please try again later.
location_denied: We could not get your location. Allow location for this page in your browser settings, then try again.
validation_not_found: {display} is not in the official postcode database yet. Check each letter and number, or try again later.
validation_bad_format: That does not look like a postcode. A postcode looks like this: LA 11 A12 GN 01.
ask_code: Say or type the postcode you want to check, or tap "Get my postcode" to share your location and find your postcode.
explain_fallback: A postcode has five parts. In LA 11 A12 GN 01: LA is the state, 11 is the Local Government Area, A12 is the district, GN is the area and 01 is the building.
not_heard: We could not hear that clearly. Please try again in a quiet place, close to the phone.
audio_too_long: That recording is too long. Please speak for less than 20 seconds.
igbo_beta: Igbo voice is in beta. If we mishear you, tap "Type instead".
waking_up: Starting up. The first answer can take up to 3 minutes. Please keep this page open.
timeout_retry: This is taking too long. Please try again in a minute.
error_slow: The postcode service is slow right now. Please try again in a minute.
error_unavailable: The postcode service is not available right now. Please try again later.
error_generic: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please try again later.
faq_what_is: A postcode is a code with five parts: state, Local Government Area (LGA), district, area and unit. It is written like AA-99-H77-BB-55, for example LA-11-A12-GN-01. Nigeria's new postcodes have been live since 1 October 2026.
faq_parts: A postcode has five parts. In LA-11-A12-GN-01: LA is the state, 11 is the Local Government Area (LGA), A12 is the district, GN is the area and 01 is the unit.
faq_since_when: Nigeria's new postcodes have been live since 1 October 2026.
faq_get_mine: To get your postcode, tap "Get my postcode" to share your location. We look up the postcode for where you are.
faq_check_one: To check a postcode, say it or type it, for example LA 11 A12 GN 01. We tell you if it is valid.
faq_place_name_no: We cannot get your postcode from a street or place name. Tap "Get my postcode" to share your location instead.
faq_privacy: We do not ask for your name, phone number or NIN. Your location is used once to find your postcode and is not kept. Voice notes are deleted after we read them.
faq_who_built: This assistant was built by an independent developer for the National AI Innovation Challenge 2026. N-ATLaS is an initiative of the Federal Ministry of Communications, Innovation and Digital Economy, and powered by Awarri Technologies. Postcode data from the Nigeria Postcode API.
warming_up: The assistant is still waking up. Please try again in a minute.
ui_intro: Find and understand your new postcode. Your location is used once, then deleted.
